title: Make the Claude cut-output checkpoint path non-leak assertion discriminating
outcome: Retained Low from independent Claude delegation-d79aaafe-47e1-4bb9-84cc-96cb358714ea/session-11150 incl authoritative coverage addendum on w-4d18277c0a1a frozen8c0cc205/base151c. src/tests/engram_claude_output_cut.rs:73 compares serialized JSON against raw single-backslash SPILL_PATH; JSON escapes backslashes, making the checkpoint assertion vacuous. Plain refusal-line assertion works and current production doesn't leak the path. This is test quality, not an observed leak. Assert recursively on actual string values or a distinctive backslash-free fragment and add a control proving a checkpoint carrying the path is rejected.
acceptance: The checkpoint non-leak control fails when the checkpoint contains the persisted output path even after JSON escaping, passes for the real current refusal, and retains the effective plain refusal-line non-leak assertion without adding file reads or changing check verdicts.
